description: Interactive hover states and animated expanding underline indicators for navigation links with reduced motion support.
implementation_notes: Implemented accessible nav links wrapped in semantic <nav aria-label="Main navigation"> with dynamic CSS transform-based expanding underline indicator (scale-x-0 to scale-x-100) and subtle vertical lift (-translate-y-0.5). Adheres to >= 1 second animation duration constraint (1000ms duration) and includes comprehensive prefers-reduced-motion accessibility overrides.
